newsitem.title: HONG KONG: StanChart sees HK housing supply rising from 1998.
newsitem.headline: StanChart sees HK housing supply rising from 1998.

text.p: Standard Chartered Bank said on Monday it predicted residential property supply in Hong Kong would increase significantly from 1998 onwards.

The bank said in a research report that "due to efforts by the government to increase land supply, and streamlining planning and development process in the last two years, supply would increase considerably in 1998 and beyond".
The report urged the government to lift the 12-month restriction on the presale of housing units so that developers could sell more flats during 1997.

The Housing Authority and the Housing Society should also try to sell more of their home ownership or sandwich class housing flats earlier, which would help to cool off the heat in the property market, it said.
The government should continue to focus its efforts to increase land supply and to make redevelopment an easier process instead of administrative measures, it said.
